descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-06 Admission Status Toggle · S17 Re-scan keeps the status the physician set; a 'NEW ADMIT' row on the list still lands as Follow-up

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Nothing is ever New Admission (or Consult) unless the physician set it: the app never guesses the status, and a patient nobody has set reads Follow-up (UAT TC-06)
  • U2 Every scanned patient defaults to Follow-up (Hospital census-photo scan and Nursing Home resident-list scan) (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 2)
  • U4 The physician can change the badge by hand at any time (before or after Generate, and on a patient whose status already rolled) through all three states, and each change persists (list, chart, reload … (UAT TC-06; TFA-92584 AC 1)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient set by hand to Consult; resident set by hand to New Admission

When Scan a census that contains the Hospital patient (same name/room) plus a new row marked 'NEW ADMIT', answer 'same patient' for the match; scan a resident list that contains the resident plus one new resident

Then Hospital patient still Consult and resident still New Admission; the new row and the new resident are Follow-up, each judged in its own chart

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT TC-06 'nothing is ever New Admission unless the physician set it' / 'changed by hand at any time' + TC-02 'existing patients' data is untouched, and new patients are added with a Follow-up badge'. oracle.mjs list text with anchors as in S01, plus a chart check for each patient whose status could be swapped (Rivera; …

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked re-scan rows built from the fixture names)); secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
